text.autoconfig.wynntitles.title: WynnTitles
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.showTi: Show other players' titles above their names. Needs Wynntils' custom nametags enabled.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.titleS: Size of titles above players, compared with their names.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.animat: Let rainbow and animated palettes move and obfuscated letters scramble. Turn off for still titles everywhere.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.announ: Post a chat message when you unlock an achievement.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.unlock: Show a pop-up in the corner when you unlock an achievement.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.server: Leave blank to use the official server. Changing it logs you in again.
text.autoconfig.wynntitles.option.previe: Debug option: shows your own title above every player.
